title: OutboundCallAudit
description: One append-only record on apa.audit.outbound-calls: a call this code's own agent made OUT to another API. Folded, never mutated, into the audit-service projection. Draft-07, not 2020-12 or 2019-09: Apicurio Registry 3.3.4's JSON Schema compatibility checker cannot determine either later draft and returns HTTP 422 for any version check against it (see _plans/versions.md).

id.description: UUID of this record; the projection's idempotency key, so a redelivery folds exactly once

correlationId.description: ties the call back to the business operation that triggered it

direction.description: always OUTBOUND: this log audits only calls this code's own agent makes out, never a call made in

target.description: the tool name, or an HTTP target for a call that is not MCP at all

argumentDigest.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the call's arguments, never the raw arguments themselves

tokensIn.description: set only when the outbound call itself is a model call with a token cost

tokensOut.description: set only when the outbound call itself is a model call with a token cost

costUsd.description: derived from tokensIn/tokensOut alone, never from content; decimal string
